name: Lucky Pack: 2026 Cup

features.name: Card-pack bonus
features.description: 3+ scatters open a bonus where you choose a pack and reveal a footballer with a multiplier.

features.name: Four pack tiers
features.description: Random, Bronze, Silver and Gold packs, with Gold offering multipliers up to 9,990x.

features.name: Bonus buy
features.description: Where permitted, the card-pack bonus can be bought directly instead of waiting for scatters.

review:
A football slot on 5x3 with 10 lines – you pick a national team before playing, and wins land to stadium noise.

The bonus is inspired by football video games: choose a card pack (Random, Bronze, Silver or Gold), then pick a card to reveal a player and a multiplier. Gold packs can hit up to 9,990x, and a Best Player tracker shows the top card of the round. Very high volatility, 10,490x max, 96.10% RTP. Great if you love opening packs.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
